evidences.evidence_quote: Alternative signals also offer intriguing solutions for audio perception, such as accelerometer signal in smartphone [1, 14, 19], mechanical signals in magnetic hard disks [17], smartphone camera image stream signals [22], COTS RFID tags [37] and so on.
evidences.evidence_context: 2.2 Audio Eavesdropping Using Alternative Signals: Alternative signals also offer intriguing solutions for audio perception, such as accelerometer signal in smartphone [1, 14, 19], mechanical signals in magnetic hard disks [17], smartphone camera image stream signals [22], COTS RFID tags [37] and so on.
